info.title: Justice Gavel API
info.description: Generated from the mounted Express routes by backend/scripts/generate-openapi.mjs. Do not edit by hand — rerun the generator after route changes (src/__tests__/openapi_drift.test.js fails on drift). Auth: most routes need `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` from POST /api/auth/login; routes marked x-auth=admin-key need the X-Admin-Key header; x-auth=public routes need neither. Billing endpoints return 503 payments_unavailable until Stripe keys are configured; AI endpoints return 503 ai_unavailable without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. See API_REFERENCE.md for the human-readable overview.

BadRequest.description: Bad request / validation error ({ error, errors?: [{ field, message, code }] })

DisclaimerRequired.description: Legal disclaimer not accepted ({ error, code: "disclaimer_required", version, text }) — accept via POST /api/auth/disclaimer/accept

Unavailable.description: Feature not configured: { error: "payments_unavailable" } (no Stripe key) or { error: "ai_unavailable" } (no Anthropic key)

Json.description: JSON body — validated in the route; a 400 lists the offending fields in `errors`.
